boards.title: Your First Weekend at Florida International University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Friday-to-Sunday introduction to FIU’s Modesto A. Maidique Campus through documented landmarks, student facilities, art, recreation and outdoor spaces.

cards.title: Friday: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Get oriented inside the Graham Center
cards.notes: Begin at GC, identify the Welcome Center and major corridors, then check the building’s digital screens for university event notices.
cards.short_summary: Use FIU’s student union as the practical starting point for learning the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU identifies the Graham Center as its student union and a destination for classes, major events, services and retail.
cards.source_title: Graham Center | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: FIU currently lists GC building hours as 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 8 a.m.–8 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; holiday hours differ.

cards.title: Friday: Find the Primera Casa Fountain
cards.subtitle: Learn one recognizable MMC landmark
cards.notes: Walk to the fountain and save its name in your phone; FIU’s admissions tour uses it as a documented Modesto Maidique Campus landmark.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your mental map with a clearly named campus-tour stop near Primera Casa.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU Admissions includes Primera Casa Fountain among the featured landmarks on its Modesto A. Maidique Campus tour.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; weather, construction and university restrictions may affect approach.

cards.title: Friday: Pause at Turtle Pond
cards.subtitle: Add a second named landmark to your route
cards.notes: Continue to Turtle Pond, observe wildlife without feeding or handling it, and note the nearest building signs before moving onward.
cards.short_summary: Turn a documented tour landmark into a calm wayfinding checkpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU Admissions features Turtle Pond as a named attraction on its Modesto A. Maidique Campus tour.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing stop; remain on designated walkways and avoid disturbing wildlife.

cards.title: Friday Evening: Scout the Observatory
cards.subtitle: Check the astronomy center’s event page
cards.notes: Photograph the observatory exterior, then check its official events section for a posted public program before planning any indoor visit.
cards.short_summary: Introduce FIU astronomy while keeping access dependent on an announced event.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU describes the Stocker AstroScience Center as a fully equipped observatory and teaching center with South Florida’s only research-grade telescope.
cards.access_notes: Do not assume interior or telescope access; FIU says upcoming events are posted on the center’s website.

cards.entity_name: Wellness and Recreation Center at MMC
cards.title: Saturday: Try the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Bring your Panther ID for student access
cards.notes: Pack athletic shoes, bring your Panther ID and start with a familiar workout; ask staff before using equipment or joining a program.
cards.short_summary: Use Saturday morning to learn where FIU students access fitness and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU says enrolled students are already recreation-center members because assessed tuition fees cover membership, and a valid Panther ID is required.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation | FIU Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: FIU currently lists Summer B 2026 weekend hours at MMC as 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify the term schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Saturday: Walk the Nature Preserve
cards.subtitle: Follow the campus preserve’s designated trails
cards.notes: Visit in daylight, stay on marked paths and bring water; use the short trail system to compare the preserve’s three ecosystems.
cards.short_summary: Experience a compact Everglades-focused outdoor classroom on the west side of MMC.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU describes the Nature Preserve as an 11-acre environmental education facility with three ecosystems, guided nature trails and a 0.6-mile jogging path.
cards.access_notes: FIU states that the preserve is open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset; use daylight hours and designated paths.

cards.title: Saturday: Browse the Frost Art Museum
cards.subtitle: See current exhibitions without an admission charge
cards.notes: Check the exhibitions page before arrival, enter during museum hours and leave time to view the three-story atrium and gallery spaces.
cards.short_summary: Make the campus art museum the structured cultural stop of the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The Frost Art Museum states that admission is always free and open to the public during normal museum hours.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Patricia & Phillip Frost Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Mondays and most legal and university holidays. Visitor parking requires payment.

cards.title: Saturday: Locate Green Lake
cards.subtitle: See a landmark tied to FIU architecture activity
cards.notes: Walk to Green Lake in daylight, identify its position on your campus route and remain in public areas away from the water’s edge.
cards.short_summary: Add a visually distinct outdoor landmark to your growing map of MMC.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU Admissions identifies Green Lake as an MMC tour landmark and documents architecture students competing there in Walk on Water.
cards.access_notes: This card is for ordinary public-area viewing, not participation in Walk on Water; follow posted campus and waterfront restrictions.

cards.title: Sunday: Find Green Library
cards.subtitle: Identify FIU’s main MMC library building
cards.notes: Locate the entrances and service signs, then check the library’s current schedule before choosing a desk or planning a return visit.
cards.short_summary: Finish the weekend knowing where a central academic resource sits on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU’s MMC page lists the Steven and Dorothea Green Library among the principal facilities located on campus.
cards.source_title: Modesto A. Maidique Campus | Florida International University
cards.access_notes: Library schedules vary by term, holiday and service area; confirm current hours on FIU Libraries’ website before entering.

cards.title: Sunday: Close Out on the GC Lawns
cards.subtitle: Review your route beside Graham Center
cards.notes: Choose a public lawn area, review the places you found and mark any buildings you still need to locate before the academic week begins.
cards.short_summary: End outside with a simple route review near the weekend’s starting point.
cards.evidence_claim: FIU Admissions features the GC Lawns as a named Modesto A. Maidique Campus tour location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-area stop; organized events, maintenance, severe weather or university rules may temporarily limit use.
